entries.say.1.neutral: So this is how it ends for you, {target.name}.
entries.say.2.neutral: You made plenty of enemies, {target.name}. I was one.
entries.say.3.neutral: I won't mourn you, {target.name}, but I won't forget this.
entries.say.4.neutral: The threat is gone. Keep moving.
entries.say.5.neutral: Maybe you finally found some peace, {target.name}.
